events.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Eli. What do you need me to do?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I’d like you to help sort donations and keep a simple list of what comes in, then we can see what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can sort the donations and keep a simple list of everything that comes in.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Sam: Sure thing—tell me what needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive — thanks for the reminder. I’ll come by Saturday around 10 and help with the shed and fence panels.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren — that’ll be a big help. I’ll sort the donations and keep the list ready for Saturday.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Oren: Great, Sam — I’ll be there at 10 on Saturday and I’m glad to help. Just point me to the tools when I arrive.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That really helps me out; I’ll see you Saturday at 10 by the garage.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Sam: Sounds good, Uli—I'll be there Saturday at 10 by the garage and ready to help.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. I really appreciate it.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s been a nice turnout. If anyone needs a tool, I’ve got a few they can borrow.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Sam: That’s great, Gus — I can help hand out tools if you need me.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who needs something and send them your way.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rey: I can help sort the repair list and match folks to the right jobs. If you know which homes still need a hand, send them my way.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Rey — I can do that. I’ll sort donations and keep a simple list of what comes in.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — that would help a lot. Send me the list when you have it, and I’ll start matching people to the jobs.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Noah: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Sam: I can help sort donations and keep a simple list of what comes in, then we’ll know what still needs fixing.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Noah: That sounds helpful—what do you want me to bring or do?
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Cleo: Oh, the repair drive—I’m keeping track of supplies. If you tell me what’s still needed, I’ll make sure it gets noted.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Cleo — I can help fill in what’s still needed. Just tell me the list, and I’ll pitch in where I can.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Cleo: Great — could you list the tools, fasteners, and any extra tables or bins we still need? I’ll note it all down.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Eli: I still need the time and a quick list of what to bring before I can plan my day.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll send you the time and a quick bring-list right away.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll wait for the time and the bring-list, then I can set my day.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: Oh, the repair drive—I’m keeping track of supplies. If you tell me what’s still needed, I’ll make sure it gets noted.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Cleo — I can help fill in what’s still needed. Just tell me the list, and I’ll pitch in where I can.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Cleo: Great—let’s note anything you can bring, and I’ll keep the supply list updated.
events.speaker: Cleo
